Compare code sets across versions of a condition definition

Source: R/versions.R
get_version_diffs.Rd

Lines up the code sets of two or more versions of a condition so you can see exactly which codes were added or removed between versions. Every version stays available unchanged (e.g. get_diabetes_type2_v1_codes() keeps returning the v1 codes after v2 is released); this function shows how they differ. Codes of every type are compared (diagnosis, procedure, HCPCS/CPT). Changes to the narrative algorithm (see the get_*_defs() functions) are not.

Usage

get_version_diffs(
  condition,
  versions = NULL,
  variable_type = c("condition", "outcome"),
  periods = FALSE,
  changes_only = FALSE,
  format = c("tibble", "flextable")
)

Arguments

condition

A single condition identifier, e.g. "diabetes_type2". See list_versions() for the available conditions and versions.

versions

The versions to compare, as labels (c("v1", "v2")) or numbers (c(1, 2)), in any order; at least two, each given once. NULL (default) compares every version of condition.

variable_type

"condition" (default) or "outcome": which definition's codes to compare. As in the get_*_codes() functions, a version with no outcome codes falls back to its condition codes.

periods

Logical. TRUE returns decimal-format codes (e.g. "250.00"). Default FALSE.

changes_only

Logical. TRUE drops codes that are in every compared version, leaving only the codes that changed. Default FALSE.

format

"tibble" (default) or "flextable". "flextable" returns a formatted table for reports (requires the flextable package): columns definition, code, one per version, type, change, with rows shaded like a GitHub diff (green: added; red: removed; grey: unchanged; yellow: the same in the first and last compared versions but changed in between, possible with three or more versions).

Value

For format = "tibble", a tibble with one row per code that appears in any of the compared versions, and columns:

  • one logical column per version (e.g. v1, v2), oldest first: TRUE if the code is in that version;

  • code: the code;

  • type: the code type (e.g. "dx_icd10");

  • definition: the code's description (from the newest version that contains it);

  • change: "unchanged", or how membership changed across the compared versions, e.g. "added in v2" or "added in v2; removed in v4".

Rows are ordered by code type, then code.

For format = "flextable", a flextable object with the same rows.

See also

list_versions() to see which versions exist.

Examples

# Every version of type 2 diabetes
get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2")
#> # A tibble: 127 × 6
#>    v1    v2    code  type    definition                                   change
#>    <lgl> <lgl> <chr> <chr>   <chr>                                        <chr> 
#>  1 TRUE  FALSE 250   dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus                            remov…
#>  2 TRUE  FALSE 2500  dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus: Diabetes mellitus withou… remov…
#>  3 TRUE  FALSE 25000 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…
#>  4 TRUE  FALSE 25002 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…
#>  5 TRUE  FALSE 25010 dx_icd9 Diabetes with ketoacidosis, type II or unsp… remov…
#>  6 TRUE  FALSE 25012 dx_icd9 Diabetes with ketoacidosis, type II or unsp… remov…
#>  7 TRUE  FALSE 2502  dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus: Diabetes with hyperosmol… remov…
#>  8 TRUE  FALSE 25020 dx_icd9 Diabetes with hyperosmolarity, type II or u… remov…
#>  9 TRUE  FALSE 25022 dx_icd9 Diabetes with hyperosmolarity, type II or u… remov…
#> 10 TRUE  FALSE 25030 dx_icd9 Diabetes with other coma, type II or unspec… remov…
#> # ℹ 117 more rows

# Specific versions, by label or by number
get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2", versions = c("v1", "v2"))
#> # A tibble: 127 × 6
#>    v1    v2    code  type    definition                                   change
#>    <lgl> <lgl> <chr> <chr>   <chr>                                        <chr> 
#>  1 TRUE  FALSE 250   dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus                            remov…
#>  2 TRUE  FALSE 2500  dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus: Diabetes mellitus withou… remov…
#>  3 TRUE  FALSE 25000 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…

#> 10 TRUE  FALSE 25030 dx_icd9 Diabetes with other coma, type II or unspec… remov…
#> # ℹ 117 more rows
get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2", versions = c(1, 2))
#> # A tibble: 127 × 6
#>    v1    v2    code  type    definition                                   change
#>    <lgl> <lgl> <chr> <chr>   <chr>                                        <chr> 
#>  1 TRUE  FALSE 250   dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus                            remov…
#>  2 TRUE  FALSE 2500  dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus: Diabetes mellitus withou… remov…
#>  3 TRUE  FALSE 25000 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…
#>  4 TRUE  FALSE 25002 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…
#>  5 TRUE  FALSE 25010 dx_icd9 Diabetes with ketoacidosis, type II or unsp… remov…

#> 10 TRUE  FALSE 25030 dx_icd9 Diabetes with other coma, type II or unspec… remov…
#> # ℹ 117 more rows

# Only the codes that changed
get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2", c(1, 2), changes_only = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 41 × 6
#>    v1    v2    code  type    definition                                   change
#>    <lgl> <lgl> <chr> <chr>   <chr>                                        <chr> 
#>  1 TRUE  FALSE 250   dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus                            remov…
#>  2 TRUE  FALSE 2500  dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus: Diabetes mellitus withou… remov…
#>  3 TRUE  FALSE 25000 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…
#>  4 TRUE  FALSE 25002 dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus without mention of compli… remov…
#>  5 TRUE  FALSE 25010 dx_icd9 Diabetes with ketoacidosis, type II or unsp… remov…

#>  7 TRUE  FALSE 2502  dx_icd9 Diabetes mellitus: Diabetes with hyperosmol… remov…

#>  9 TRUE  FALSE 25022 dx_icd9 Diabetes with hyperosmolarity, type II or u… remov…
#> 10 TRUE  FALSE 25030 dx_icd9 Diabetes with other coma, type II or unspec… remov…
#> # ℹ 31 more rows

# As a formatted table
if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  get_version_diffs("diabetes_type2", changes_only = TRUE, format = "flextable")
}
